name: Confident disagreement fade
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: side correct if the picked club wins the game.
signal: the OPPOSITE of sign(margin_b) when the two estimators disagree by ≥ 5 pts
thesis: A large disagreement means one model is out of its depth; the raw-margin estimator has scored better out-of-sample than the opponent-adjusted one in the v3 walk-forward, so the rule takes its side — and that direction is a finding, not an assumption, so it is fixed here before scoring.
threshold: |margin_a − margin_b| ≥ 5.0; pick the side of estimator A
